domain:server#5 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jRsWwTRkuRCyQwvpAG
Scope addition at 2026-11-15T16:01Z, the maintainer 2026-11-15T16:00Z: 「复审车道和你这里的复审不是一个概念吗？ 你派出的任务需要审核，但未必都需要契约复审」.

So the fix also states, in area-lease.md, that an area-lease seat's review threads are its PR review threads, not the review lane: every dispatched PR gets their ordinary review (the dispatch seat's ACCEPT read per `review-checklist.md`), and the contract review is a separate step owed only on `contract-review.md`'s four faces. `lanes/review.md`'s seat rules (account, mailbox, record-only writes) apply to review-lane seats only. Fix lands in PR #33938 with `Fixes #34007`.

- 2026-11-15T16:06Z, decision card, option chosen: 「50 行内由区自审」. A PR of ≤50 lines that is text/pin-only and Clause-② no is reviewed by its own area.
- 2026-11-15T16:08Z, project chat: 「同意他的建议：每区先开 2 个开发代理，上一个 PR 进了合并队列再领下一张卡；不单独做 p3；只复审已经变绿、不再改的提交；线程 effort 用 high。」 ("他的建议" is server seat 6's proposal.)
